value.rationale: The natural four-bit Hamming metric defines a canonical 15-dimensional transportation Banach ball. Existing literature records aggregate 990 and maximal insphere contacts only; the complete 16-orbit classification, representatives, and all 10 Euclidean facet distance shells expose substantial previously unrecorded structural geometry. It is a motivated complete finite classification with explicit proof and useful benchmark for natural graph-metric norm geometry, without unsupported claim of downstream theorem or all-dimension pattern.
